content: We use dropout BIBREF21 with the probability $p=0.3$. All trainable parameters, except word embeddings, are randomly initialized with the Xavier uniform in $(-0.1, 0.1)$ BIBREF22. For optimization in the training, we use SGD as the optimizer with a minibatch size of 64 and an initial learning rate of 1.0. We train the model for 15 epochs and start halving the learning rate after the 8th epoch. We set the gradient norm upper bound to 3 during the training.
